Definition: a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other)
BiblicalUsage: Machlaphah is a lock of hair, and both of its appearances belong to Samson. Judges 16:13 has him telling Delilah to weave the seven locks of his head with the web, and Judges 16:19 has her shaving off the seven locks of his head while he slept, and his strength went from him.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the locks were never the strength itself, but the sign of the vow Samson had already been breaking piece by piece.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
